movelist.name: Power Swap
movelist.effect: The user and the target trade Combat Stage values for the Attack Stat, and then for the Special Attack Stat.

movelist.name: Guard Swap
movelist.effect: The user and the target trade Combat Stage values for the Defense Stat, and then for the Special Defense Stat.

movelist.name: Amnesia
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Special Defense 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Psycho Cut
movelist.effect: Psycho Cut is a Critical Hit on 18+.

movelist.name: Mist
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Mist may activate it when having Combat Stages lowered by any effect; if they do, those Combat Stages are instead not lowered. Mist may be activated 3 times, and then disappears.

movelist.name: Miracle Eye
movelist.effect: Miracle Eye may be activated as a Swift Action on the user’s turn. For the rest of the turn, the user’s Psychic-Type Moves can hit and affect Dark-Type targets, and the user can see through the Illusion Ability, Moves with the Illusion keyword, and effects created by the Illusionist Capability, ignoring all effects from those.

abilities.name: Unnerve
abilities.effect: The target cannot gain positive Combat Stages or trade in Digestion Buffs for 1 full round.

abilities.name: Frighten
abilities.effect: Lower the target’s Speed 2 Combat Stages.

abilities.name: Memory Wipe
abilities.effect: If used as a Swift Action, the last Move used by the target becomes Disabled. If used as a Standard Action, the target is Flinched and Paralyzed. If used as an Extended Action that takes about 1 minute, it can erase up to 10 minutes that have occurred within the last 30 minutes from the target’s memory.
